test_title: PYST 09: RRB ALP CBT I - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Nov 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of C. Only two people sit between D and C. A sits to the immediate right of D. E sits to the immediate left of G. B sits second to the left of A.

How many people sit between B and F?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only two people sit to the right of C. Only two people sit between D and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4f447d120e76ba09f45b86595f7ad79a0221f704179a75d1c89e25db1cfea8b.png] 

A sits to the immediate right of D. B sits second to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b880a513e3878aa1e7f69bae44f94ee0c23dc93a15e4c7295e20d88e964b98b.png] 

E sits to the immediate left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/843261a8f40e97678180361e459649265123d2febf80aa22fdd610b8785d66a0.png] 

Final arrangement,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59e4e3fdf8e0dd1c1f5757dca6ef1598ad9f66781e538ccdb0b8364439fa3896.png] 

Thus, Only two people sit between B and F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
